I 100% recommend this veterinary clinic! 🐾❤️

I've been taking my little Chula here since she was a puppy, and I'm always completely satisfied with their care. The clinic is very professional, caring, and above all, you can tell that the well-being of our four-legged companions is a real priority for the entire team.

A special mention goes to the veterinary assistants, who are always attentive, available, and very pleasant. And a big thank you to Dr. Badruna, who is remarkably gentle and kind. She takes her time, reassures, and cares for Chula with great tenderness.

A clinic I completely trust with my little dog. Thank you to the whole team for your kindness and professionalism! 🐶💕

First visit for our kitten Serj, and we were welcomed by the incredible team, including Dr. Badruna, who immediately put us at ease and reassured us about the next steps to ensure our son is perfect! They handled the cat very well, and the atmosphere was relaxed and caring.

Thank you again!

(As you can see, he even fell asleep on the keyboard!)
I simply want to thank the lovely secretary and the team who found us an emergency appointment slot after an unforeseen problem. A thousand thanks!

I can't judge the veterinarians' competence since our appointment didn't happen. We had an appointment at 3 PM. Upon arrival, we were told the veterinarian would see us. Forty-five minutes later, we asked about the status. We were told the veterinarian had an emergency and would be finished in about 15 minutes. As we had another matter to attend to, we had to leave. The problem is that if we had been told there would be a delay upon arrival, we would certainly have rescheduled the appointment. Instead, we were made to wait 45 minutes.

My senior dog has been receiving physiotherapy there for two years, and it has allowed her to regain mobility and effectively manage her pain. Dr. Legrand was very attentive and professional; thanks to her, we were able to overcome this difficult time, and she continues to help us progress and stabilize her condition. I'm so glad I found this kind of service; otherwise, my dog ​​might not have been able to walk again, and I wouldn't have this extra time with her. Thank you to her and the entire team.
I recently chose this clinic to get a second medical opinion on my 22-year-old cat. Thank you for your kindness towards animals and their owners.

We have been going to this clinic for six years now for our cats, dogs, and many other animals rescued from the streets.

The veterinarians are fantastic!

This clinic, managed by Dr. Legrand, whose skills are proven and constantly evolving for the well-being of our companions, offers us a comfortable and top-notch environment, both for us humans and our animals. Dr. Badruna and Dr. Schneider, with their kindness, attentiveness, empathy, and qualifications, make for an exceptional veterinary team.

Despite all these qualities and skills, this clinic wouldn't be the same without the veterinary assistants, Eugénie and Sophie!
They are dedicated, committed, and highly qualified. They are the guarantors of the organization, management, and smooth running of the day! They are the backbone of this team!

Thank you all.

P.S.: They like both savory and sweet, so feel free to mix and match; they'll always be happy 😁

We've been taking our dog to this clinic for several years and I recommend them 100%. Our dog became very ill at the end of May 2026, so we had to call the emergency vet, then another vet closer to home. Both felt our dog was doomed and wouldn't make it through the night. The diagnosis was very pessimistic, largely due to his age (16 years old). No thorough examinations were carried out, even though there were some positive signs regarding his health, because, again, they deemed it unnecessary given his age and therefore no treatment was given, because they felt there was nothing to be done, "he's already lived a full life." But fortunately, we were then able to arrange to bring him here. The clinic found us an emergency appointment that very morning, and our dog received completely different care. He was thoroughly examined and treated; in the end, he "only" had indigestion, albeit quite severe, which was quickly and easily cured with the prescribed medication. It was a very frightening and painful experience, and it could have been much shorter for both him and us if we had been able to consult them directly, as we usually do. Our dog is now doing well again! A HUGE thank you for your consideration of animals at every stage of their lives. The veterinarian was very gentle, and it's truly reassuring to be able to have the additional tests done right there. I have complete confidence in this clinic and recommend it 1000%! THANK YOU!

Hello Ms. Das Neves Marques,
Thank you so much for this review.

The entire team thanks you for your trust and support.

Sincerely,
Berthelot Veterinary Clinic
Dr. Legrand

Hello,
Thank you so much for your 5-star review! We are delighted to have been able to assist you and your four-legged companion.

Sincerely,
Berthelot Veterinary Clinic
Dr. Legrand

Dr. Legrand guided us through the care and passing of our beloved cat, Chiquita, with great professionalism and compassion. His humanity was such a comfort during this very difficult time. All the staff were equally professional and empathetic. Thank you for everything.
A very kind veterinary clinic, attentive and caring towards animals, I highly recommend it!

Hello Ms. Marti,
Thank you for your feedback. We have been committed to supporting you all these years.

Sincerely,
Berthelot Veterinary Clinic
Dr. Legrand
Terrible customer service. They try to force you to book a €70 appointment to buy a €5 deworming treatment 😭 …

You can go there with your eyes closed. It was our first time with the vet for our cat, and she was very reassuring. We were able to ask lots of questions without ever feeling judged; on the contrary, we felt very understood. Plus, the price is reasonable.
Thank you for your welcome.

I'm happy, they're very nice,

And they have excellent service

This message is not intended as a reprimand, but I believe it is necessary to report this incident. While my rabbit's accident might be understandable from a human perspective, his suffering is professionally unacceptable.

On Tuesday, May 5, 2026, I dropped off my rabbit for teeth filing, a procedure he had undergone before. I picked him up that afternoon. I was told everything went smoothly.
At home, my rabbit hasn't left his carrier. I initially mistook this for lethargy, but his condition alarms me.
Upon handling him, I noticed that his entire lower body was paralyzed (it felt like holding a disarticulated body). His posture in the carrier was abnormal; anyone who handled him could see it. He tried to move, but in vain, flailing his front paws.
It only requires hands.

That evening, at the Mermoz emergency clinic, an X-ray revealed a broken vertebra, and he was developing intestinal stasis due to paralysis.

My rabbit had to be euthanized.

I can't be any clearer: I don't condemn the accident that occurred at the vet's. Broken vertebrae are common in rabbits. I absolutely do not condemn the accidental cause of my pet's death.

However, returning an animal to its owner in such a state, with the obvious symptoms of paralysis and suffering, is something I cannot accept.
I am simply appealing to the conscience of those who handled my rabbit, Lorrain, which is why I am documenting this event.
I understand the condolences I have received and I harbor no ill will toward the clinic. I don't care about compensation; the harm that compels me to write is the pain my rabbit endured between his surgery at that clinic and his euthanasia at the Mermoz emergency room.
The real harm isn't mine, but the irreparable loss suffered by my deceased pet.
I appeal to your moral conscience regarding the suffering of my Lorrain and to the vigilance of owners who might entrust their animals to careless hands.
Always delighted to go. My dog ​​is always happy to go, oddly enough! A top-notch team!

From the bottom of my heart, I thank Dr. Legrand and her entire team for their warm welcome, their attentive listening, their patience, their care of the animal, and the respect they showed her. These are precious qualities these days. Dr. Legrand demonstrated great compassion and kindness as she accompanied my cat, Lilou, on her journey to animal heaven. Thank you to her and the entire team at the Berthelot Veterinary Clinic. 🙏
They took good care of my Hector, who had diarrhea.
Excellent welcome and service, we are very happy to have found our veterinarian in the new premises.

Doctors Legrand and Badruna are simply perfect, as is their team of assistants, who are very attentive. Macha was seen immediately as an emergency, and thank you again for your availability.

Furthermore, their prices are very affordable.
Don't hesitate, go there if you have any problems with your pet. The brand-new clinic is beautiful, nothing like the old one.

Dr. Legrand and Dr. Badruna helped save Théïa's life. She wouldn't be with us today without their keen observation (detecting a rare congenital heart defect through a simple examination), their professionalism (pre- and post-operative care and support), their patience (especially with me!), their advice, and their kindness.

I can't thank them enough. Thank you for being a part of our lives. 💙

Excellent veterinary clinic. I saw three different vets and they were all truly wonderful. The team takes the time to explain things, they are very attentive and caring towards the animals, and they offer great advice (nutrition, stress relief, etc.). Thank you!

Flexible payment options. Quality care. My kitten Gaia has been going there for six months now; every time she goes for serious issues, they resolve them at a lower cost. By far the best value for money in Lyon. Thank you to the whole team!

Dr. Legrand and his team saved my little Ibiza, a 12-year-old Chihuahua.

I can never thank them enough for their tenacity, patience, dedication, gentleness, and kindness.
Dr. Legrand was able to diagnose her condition and did everything he could to alleviate her suffering and save her life. Few veterinarians are capable of such a feat.

[REC]
If, to my great surprise, Mrs. Bradruna still works at the Berthelot Clinic, I hope she reads this message. I could title it "He still had his baby teeth" or "He wasn't even 5 months old," but after all, it doesn't matter, it won't bring him back... his name was Vulcan. He was a Chihuahua with a magnificent wolf-gray coat. I hope at least you remember him.
I brought him to you as an emergency on Saturday, December 14, 2024. He was vomiting and refusing to eat. I hadn't seen him do it, but I strongly suspected he had swallowed an earplug, not foam, but some kind of silicone plastic. Since I insisted, you took an X-ray. You assured me you saw nothing. In any case, for you, it was just gastroenteritis. I told you about the timing, specifically the possibility of him swallowing the blockage—which worried me greatly, it was the reason I came. But according to you, if he had swallowed it, it might still be in his stomach, and, to quote you, there was no immediate urgency (you'll tell me later, a sock can be found in a dog's stomach several weeks after ingestion, no reason to rush). I was supposed to go home, give him treatment for his gastroenteritis (an anti-nausea medication and Ulcar), and give you an update on Monday. I asked you to email me the X-ray; I insisted. But you didn't. Condemning him a second time. It could have been useful to us in the emergency room... The first time: it was because the blockage was clearly visible on the X-ray.

He died shortly after arriving at the emergency room, during the night. I want you to know that he suffered greatly.

What pains me is imagining your colleagues comforting you after my visit on Monday or Tuesday, I can't remember exactly (time stood still for me). Thank you anyway for reminding me to take my phone with me before leaving; it would have been a shame to lose the recording of your confession, which arrived so late (no explanation was provided to me by email, of course).

[REC]
Excellent vet, lovely with our little treasure, gentle and patient, thank you to her and her colleague.

Thank you to the entire team for your kindness and consideration.
Thank you so much for your wonderful human touch during these sometimes very complicated and difficult times.

Hello,
Thank you for your feedback. We remain at your service to continue meeting the best needs of your animals.

Sincerely,
Berthelot Veterinary Clinic
Dr. Legrand

Excellent consultation. Very welcoming. The young veterinarian I met was very attentive. I was worried about my little Frisou, and she reassured me, providing all the necessary explanations regarding his growth and diet. She took the time to examine him thoroughly. I highly recommend this clinic, where I entrust the health and well-being of my little Frisou without hesitation.
Excellent vet and team. Very patient, friendly, and dedicated. Plus, it's affordable.

Wonderful Dr. Badruna and Dr. Legrand! I was in a panic because my son's cat had swallowed an earplug before I left for Canada (never mind Canada, Fanta's health comes first).
They were treated very quickly, the surgery was just as fast, Dr. Legrand even cut short her weekend to come and operate and take her home for recovery. Above all, she provided clear explanations, good advice, regular updates after her hospitalization, and excellent follow-up.
We got our cat back in perfect health with a beautiful scar.
Thank you to them for their professionalism, dedication, skills, and kindness; you saved her life ❤️. They are passionate and put the animal first 🤗.

And thank you to the whole team, you are the best!
Fanta thanks you so much. 😺😽
Our little Quantum was sterilized today, the scar is tiny and the stitches are inside the skin, the area is perfect, no shameful Elizabethan collar for my little darling or even an itchy bandage!

Hello,
Thank you for your feedback. We remain at your service to continue meeting the best needs of your animals.

Sincerely,
Berthelot Veterinary Clinic
Dr. Legrand
A huge thank you to all the staff for being so efficient and kind from the beginning to the end of my beautiful Pluch's life 🤍 …

Hello Mr. Tenadet,
Thank you very much for your excellent rating. The entire team thanks you for your trust.
We hope Delta is doing well and would be delighted to welcome you back.

Sincerely,
Berthelot Veterinary Clinic
Dr. Legrand

Veterinarians like you rarely see. Always attentive, caring, and available! My dog ​​has been seen by Dr. Legrand for about five years, and I have complete confidence in her. She takes the time to explain the diagnosis in detail. Always available for any questions, even outside of regular business hours. I've also had appointments with the other veterinarians, and they are all truly excellent and passionate about their work. I recommend her 1000000%!

A very compassionate and attentive veterinary practice! You can tell they are passionate and love animals.

I want to thank the team again for everything you did for Tichat, right up to the very end.

A warm welcome from the entire team. Prompt and professional care. Their human and medical expertise saved our cat, Lennon. Attentive and compassionate post-operative follow-up. I warmly and sincerely recommend this clinic.

This clinic is fantastic, and the vets are honest. My dog, who has been reactive to people since she was a puppy, is treated there, and they are understanding and adapt to various issues. We are primarily seen by Dr. Bardula, but we also see Dr. Legrand, and they are both very attentive to our needs. The veterinary assistant team is also excellent. I highly recommend them.
The vet was very empathetic and attentive; she took good care of my cat. I highly recommend her.

Hello,
Thank you so much for your 5-star review! We are delighted to have been able to assist you and your four-legged companion.

Sincerely,
Berthelot Veterinary Clinic
Dr. Legrand
Perfect, attentive, practical, friendly. In short, thank you very much 🙂🙂🙂 …

Excellent veterinary clinic. We are always well cared for by the vets, who are very kind and passionate about their work; you can tell they truly love animals.

Thank you for what you do.
I highly recommend them!

Sincerely,

Dr. Legrand
We take our dog to this clinic and are very happy with it! Veïko, who is very anxious, never resists going, which is a good indicator of the quality of care. I highly recommend it.

They're the best!
Great with animals
Pain relief center
Highly recommended

Absolutely fantastic! The kindness and genuine love for animals are something I've rarely seen, evident in every member of staff. The building is also conveniently located near a pet shop, perfect for those extra purchases after a vet visit. I recommend it 100%! 🤍 …

A truly excellent clinic.
Superb reception.
The veterinarians are always attentive.
Ms. Legrand is very caring towards our animals.
She took wonderful care of my poodle, who passed away at 19.
And she is very supportive when it comes to making difficult decisions.
And she helps us through our grief.
Truly a fantastic team.
Loving animals.

The staff were very friendly and the doctors professional. I highly recommend them. They operated on my cat and everything went well. Thank you again for the way you take care of our little companions.
Sometimes late for appointments, but that can happen, just like with the doctor. Excellent follow-up, a true professional for my cat for the past 5 years.

My cat fell from the 4th floor. The clinic immediately allowed me to bring him in for an emergency examination, even though they had no other appointments available that day. A huge thank you to everyone for their work and for answering my questions. Umi is doing very well now ☺️

My little Saïko (a 3-year-old Shiba Inu) has been a patient there since he was 3 months old. Yesterday, he unfortunately injured his paw during a walk on a piece of glass lying in the grass. The clinic was able to take Saïko in the very next morning (a Saturday, the day before a bank holiday weekend) even though they were fully booked! For that alone, I am incredibly grateful; thanks to them, I know Saïko is in good hands. His recovery is now just a matter of time with his treatment and care. I highly recommend this veterinary clinic!

First visit with my 11-week-old puppy for a booster vaccination. The doctor was amazing with my puppy, showing a gentleness and understanding that only truly dedicated people possess. His advice was relevant, the examination very thorough, and the doctor was incredibly kind. I'm so glad I found this clinic. Thank you so much!
A huge THANK YOU to the whole team for taking such good care of my Potato, for your dedication. You were extraordinary!

Without a doubt, one of the best veterinary clinics in Lyon! Attentive, caring and competent professionals, honest fees, relevant advice and optimal care – I can only recommend taking your little companions there.

Great service and hospitality from the receptionist and Dr. Badruna. They both spoke enough English and spent enough time to make me feel comfortable when getting my Dalmatians passport to return home to the UK. Very Professional and would recommend the Clinique. Thank you to you both.
My animals have been cared for there for several years and I am very satisfied.

I wanted to thank Dr. Legrand for taking the time to care for my cat, Inouki. We love animals and care for them with gentleness and compassion for their owners. And a big thank you to the entire team who called to check on us. A top-notch veterinary practice.
A top-notch veterinary clinic that takes care of our animals with great seriousness and gentleness, and warmly supports the owners.
